paras: Crown Power Energy Systems Ltd ("Crown Power", "we", "us") is the data controller for personal data collected through this website. We are a company registered in England and Wales (Company No. 16070400).
This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how we use it and the rights available to you.
We collect information you provide directly to us — for example when you complete an enquiry, application or contact form.
list: Contact details such as your name, email address and telephone number
Information about your enquiry, project or application
Any documents you choose to share with us
Basic technical data collected automatically when you use the site

paras: We use personal data to respond to your enquiry, assess applications, provide our services and communicate with you.
list: Responding to enquiries and providing information you request
Assessing internship, training and job applications
Managing our relationship with clients, partners and contractors
Meeting our legal and regulatory obligations

paras: We rely on one or more lawful bases under applicable data-protection law, including your consent, the performance of a contract, our legitimate interests in operating our business, and compliance with legal obligations.
We do not sell your personal data. We may share it with trusted service providers who help us operate our business, and where required by law. Any such sharing is subject to appropriate safeguards.
We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy, or as required by law, after which it is securely deleted.
Subject to applicable law, you have rights over your personal data.
list: Access to the personal data we hold about you
Erasure of your data in certain circumstances
Objection to, or restriction of, certain processing
Withdrawal of consent where processing is based on consent

paras: To exercise your rights or ask a question, please contact us using the details below. If you are in the UK and are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO).
